version_floor: not established: only zellij 0.45.1 was probed and validated; the adapter gates on behavior (nonzero exit, unknown subcommand or unrecognized list-clients columns fail selection) rather than a version number
provenance_detail: real zellij server, panes and PTY clients in an isolated socket, config, cache and data directory; selection read back with list-clients and confirmed by keystroke routing
multi_client_rule: success requires list-clients to show the target pane for at least one client; focus-pane-id moves only the client that most recently sent input
gui_activation: Linux only, exactly one attached client: the agent's ancestry reaches the daemonized server, whose accepted sockets are mapped to client PIDs with a sock_diag netlink dump plus /proc/<pid>/fd links; the one interactive client's ancestry gives the parent emulator. Validated against an instrumented parent; no KWin, qdbus or xdotool calls were made
parent_activation_rule: activation is claimed only when list-clients shows one client, the server socket name matches the session, and exactly one interactive peer (plain zellij or attach after global options, with a controlling tty) is connected; action peers are ignored, any other peer (web, watch, pipe, subscribe, run, edit, plugin, unknown), several clients or a mismatch is refused, and the client's start time must be unchanged before and after parent activation
pre_upgrade_record_detail: session recorded before zellij pane capture; restart the agent session to enable selection

before_any_client_input.detail: no zellij client moved to pane 1

activation.detail: no parent terminal emulator found for zellij

two_clients_activation.detail: several zellij clients attached; cannot tell which one shows the pane

unknown_pane.detail: zellij could not focus pane 99: CLI missing, timed out, unknown pane or unsupported version

closed_pane.detail: zellij could not focus pane 2: CLI missing, timed out, unknown pane or unsupported version

watcher_activation.detail: a zellij watch client is attached; cannot tell which window shows the pane

bare_record_control.detail: zellij reports no active session in the default socket dir; the session may use a custom ZELLIJ_SOCKET_DIR

socket_dir_isolation: private temporary ZELLIJ_SOCKET_DIR, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and TMPDIR for every zellij invocation; the default-dir control resolves inside the private XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
